record.paper_title: Local and Global Methods in Data Mining: Basic Techniques and Open Problems
record.original_question: Let R be a relation schema, let Q be a class of Boolean queries on data sets over R, and let k be an integer. Find k Boolean queries α₁, ..., α_k such that, for every data set d over R, the answers to α₁, ..., α_k on d suffice to answer every query β in Q on the same data set.

evidence.quote: Problem 16 Given a relation schema R and a class of boolean queries Q for datasets over R and an integer k. Find k queries α1,...,αk such that for all datasets d over R we can answer any query β ∈ Q on d using the answers of αi on d.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let R be a relation schema, and let D(R) denote the class of all finite data sets (instances) over R. A Boolean query on D(R) is a function β : D(R) → {0,1}. Fix a class Q of Boolean queries on D(R) and a positive integer k.

Determine k Boolean queries α₁, …, α_k on D(R) (not required to belong to Q) with the following property: there exists a function F : {0,1}^k × Q → {0,1} such that, for every data set d ∈ D(R) and every query β ∈ Q,
   β(d) = F(α₁(d), …, α_k(d), β).
That is, the k bits (α₁(d), …, α_k(d)) constitute a sufficient summary of d for answering every query in Q.

Equivalently, find α₁, …, α_k such that whenever two data sets d, d′ ∈ D(R) satisfy α_i(d) = α_i(d′) for all i = 1, …, k, then β(d) = β(d′) for all β ∈ Q.

Characterize, for a given schema R, query class Q, and integer k, when such α₁, …, α_k exist, and provide a method for constructing them when they do.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is a general open question about constructing optimal Boolean summary queries for a class Q. No specific resolution was located; the problem appears to remain open in its general formulation, while special cases (e.g., frequent itemsets, particular query classes) have been studied in the data-mining and database-theory literature without yielding a general solution.

status_evidence.title: Local and Global Methods in Data Mining (zbMATH)
status_evidence.snippet: Listed as an open problem on optimal summary statistics for query classes.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is posed as open with no general known resolution.
